Messages.Author: Ian batty
Messages.Body:
Situation:

Arika has anathama played on her by my predator.
I play Minion Tap and then hunt with her.
Predator intercepts and inflicts damage on Arika.

According to the card text she is burned only if she is REDUCED to zero
blood by damage, but she is already on zero blood.

What happens?

Thanks,
Ian

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:


If she doesn't prevent the damage, she goes to torpor.
If she does, she stays ready.
Either way, Anathema won't be activated, since (as you say) she is
not *reduced* to zero blood.

From: Wot...@aol.com (Jon Wilkie)
Newsgroups: rec.games.trading-cards.jyhad
Subject: Weekly Rulings, Volume 1
Date: Wed, 13 Nov 1996 12:27:49 -0800
Message-ID: <WotCCST-1311...@w11-63.wizards.com>

QUESTION: Anathema: Is the "only kicks in if the vampire is reduced to 0
blood due to effects errata? Would that allow a vampire to burn his own
blood paying costs (of combat cards) to "save" himself from Anathema?

ANSWER: Yes. If the vampire is reduced to zero Blood due to combat
damage, blood theft, etc., then Anathema's effect goes off.
